requirement: A Design system press is one Site changes row on every CMS (WordPress's own files no longer a second 'source unknown' row), reads Type 'Design system' / 'Applied by <person>' with distinct apply, switch and undo sentences in eight languages, and a failure inside tracy-web's WebSocket upgrade handshake no longer ends the process

oracle.ref: PR #1134 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-walkthrough-2026-10-11/README.md bugs 3, 4, 5 (A-wordpress/14-site-changes.png, 15-site-changes-apply-row.png, 15b-site-changes-unknown-row.png); the WordPress paths were computed with the new script lines in dswalkwp01-web-1 (read only).
oracle.invariant: S1: a WordPress apply answers files ['wp-content/uploads/tracy/styles/ds-od-<id>.json', 'wp-content/uploads/tracy/inspirations.json'] (EmDash and Joomla: []); the door keeps them on the site_write target; GET /api/sites/:key/activity?version=2 lists one writes row per press and no outside-files row for a seal holding only those files (counts.unknown 0), and the row carries effects.files {count: 2, sha: <seal>}. A seal with one more file, sealed before the press, or of a press with no files or an unknown outcome stays its own Unknown row. S2: the press's row has origin.source 'design-system', actor.role 'executor', no executor, and description keys design-system.apply {name}, design-system.switch {name, from}, design-system.undo {name}; the chat route's apply (target.channel 'chat') and a row recorded before the channel stay 'chat'. en: 'Applied the design system “Stripe”', 'Switched the design system from “Stripe” to “Spotify”', 'Undid the design system “Spotify”'; vi, de, it, fr, nl, zh, es carry all five keys. S3: the upgrade listener resolves (never rejects) when resolver.canonicalize or seatFor throws EAI_AGAIN, destroys that socket and logs one '[ws] handshake for … dropped: EAI_AGAIN …' line; a client socket error while it awaits throws nothing.
